description: Read a clip project item's transcript as JSON (the Text panel's transcript, with word timings). Returns it, or writes it to a .json file when outputFile is given

item.description: A project item: its id (from list_project_items), its bin path such as "Footage/Interviews/a.mov", or its name when that is unique

name.description: Item name, when only one item has it

path.description: Bin path, "/"-separated, from the project root

outputFile.description: Absolute path of a .json file to write instead of returning the transcript

name: export_transcript
title: Export Transcript
